text: Rapidity is defined by φ = arctanh(v/c), with γ = cosh φ and βγ = sinh φ. Unlike velocities, rapidities ___ linearly when collinear boosts are composed.
explanation: For collinear boosts the rapidities are additive, φ_total = φ₁ + φ₂, whereas velocities combine by u = (u'+v)/(1+u'v/c²). Because γ = cosh φ and βγ = sinh φ, a boost is a hyperbolic rotation through angle φ. Summing N equal rapidities gives velocity tanh(Nφ), which approaches but never reaches c.
